name: matvec_gpt2_124m
description: Weight-streaming sequencer for the MAC chiplet: walks a matrix column by column, drives the MAC, drains its 2-stage pipeline and flags each finished column

derivation.rule: address widths from the longest reduction; the drain count is the MAC's own pipeline depth, so a change there changes this block

ports.name: w_addr
ports.desc: weight index, column major: col*depth + row

ports.name: mac_clear
ports.desc: clear the MAC accumulator before the next column

ports.name: col_valid
ports.desc: the MAC accumulator holds a finished column

behavior: start begins a product of cols columns, each a reduction of depth elements.
For each column the sequencer issues depth consecutive addresses with mac_valid high, a_addr walking 0..depth-1 and w_addr walking col*depth..col*depth+depth-1.
It then holds mac_valid low for 2 cycles, the MAC's own pipeline depth, before asserting col_valid for one cycle with col_index set.
mac_clear is asserted after col_valid so the next column starts from zero. Without it every column accumulates into the one before it.
busy is high from start until the last column is flagged.
Memory reads are asynchronous: data is expected in the same cycle as the address.
